description: Philips Hue bridge — policy-only module for firewall rules (no VM)
_comment_zoning: ADR-COM-0006: Hue moved iotLocal->iotCloud to co-locate with the SysAP control plane (deconz+sysap). SysAP discovers+controls Hue INTRA-zone (native SSDP/mDNS, no cross-zone relay); enables firmware updates (cloud-only). HA/app still discover via udpbroadcastrelay to srvHome/home (discoveryMdns). Trade: shares flat iotCloud segment (accepted blast radius). Promotion path -> dedicated domotica zone (ADR-COM-0006 alt C).
